subject: english
title: Word Roots · Q2 W02 D04
objective: Identify a base word, or root, in common related words.
introduction: Milo has a new mission! 🐱✨ A root or base word carries the central meaning. Word endings can change how the word is used. Ready to explore?

vocabulary.definition: to make something free of dirt
to make music with your voice

items.prompt: Which pair shows a root word and a related word?
items.explanation: The answer is “clean — cleaned.” It uses what we learned about base words.

items.prompt: Which is the base word in 'cleaned'?
items.explanation: The answer is “clean.” It uses what we learned about base words.

items.prompt: Which word was made from the root 'clean'?
items.explanation: The answer is “cleaned.” It uses what we learned about base words.

items.prompt: Which pair does NOT belong with the others?
items.explanation: "cat — dog" names two animals, not a word family. The other pairs share a base word and a related word.

items.prompt: What is the root word of 'singer'?
items.explanation: The answer is “sing.” It uses what we learned about base words.
